_validation_note: 14-day window (June 6-20) was applied first. Zero candidates survived. The window was then broadened to 21 days (May 30-June 20) per the retry protocol. Still zero candidates survived. CANDIDATE B (GCI-Quintillion FCC TAD): Gate 1 FAILS — ADN acquisition announcement is April 22, 2026, outside both windows; no new FCC action editorial coverage in window. Gate 2 FAILS independently — no FCC cable landing license transfer application has been filed as of June 20, 2026; all mechanism layers hypothetical. CANDIDATE C (Terra Energy Center DOE DPA Coal Grant Stack): Gate 4 FAILS regardless of window. WebFetch confirmed the ADN June 5, 2026 article contains no mention of AI data centers, AI computing, or artificial intelligence. The DOE HGEO project selections page describes the project as 'Restoring Reliability: Coal Recommissioning and Modernization' with no AI language. The ADN June 19 opinion column mentions 'data centers' once in a generic list alongside 'mines, manufacturers' — not AI specifically. No fetched primary source establishes a DIRECT AI consequence. Gate 5 FAILS independently — Army Corps Alaska District website (poa.usace.army.mil) returned ECONNREFUSED, preventing confirmation of current District Commander from a fetchable primary source; 33 CFR 325.8(b) confirms District Engineer authority is conditional (must refer to Division Engineer in specified circumstances); Mat-Su Borough Assembly is multi-member; RCA is 5-member. Gate 1 under 21-day broadened window: ADN June 5 article passes, but moot given Gate 4 and Gate 5 failures. CANDIDATE A (USCG Arctic Security Cutter Kodiak/Seward Shore Infrastructure Stack): Gate 1 PASSES under 14-day window (ADN June 11, 2026, confirmed independent editorial). Gate 5 PASSES — 14 U.S.C. § 504(a)(2) confirmed Commandant sole authority; Adm. Kevin Lunday named as decision-maker. Gate 4 FAILS — WebFetch of full ADN article text returned zero mentions of AI systems, C2 connectivity, Project Minerva, maritime domain awareness technology, or any AI-related capability. Tutor Perini $81.8M contract (confirmed) is for Family Housing Phase IV and Aviation Hill water tank — not C2 or AI infrastructure. AI connection is inferential, not direct and documentable. Gate 4 is a hard fail. CONCLUSION: Zero mechanisms survive all seven gates after 21-day broadening. Seventh consecutive no-target run (June 12-20, 2026). Core failure mode across candidates A and C is Gate 4 — AI consequences are inferential, not directly documented in fetchable independent editorial or primary sources. The bar was not lowered.
